observations.behavior: Defines band model implementations and widening, including Poisson and NegativeBinomial, and delegates MAD, ZScore, IQR to the alerts detector registry.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements count-aware asymmetric bands and fallbacks to Poisson when dispersion is not overdispersed, supporting the APM anomaly detection without requiring ClickHouse or Django setup.
